title: Which measure should 'thinnest wall' and 'tightest gap' use, now that the sweep's measure reads the thickest place on smooth TPMS?
context: Building decision 0010 showed that the sweep's thinnest-feature measure (14d) keeps only local peaks of the distance map. On smooth shapes like Schwarz P those are just the node centres (8 points), so it reports 82.5 of 96 voxels (4.3 mm in a 5 mm cell) instead of the neck. It works on even struts and plates and on rough fields (spinodoid 2.5 voxels). The textbook maximal-ball test overshoots the other way (387,000 points, 5th percentile 3.3 voxels from surface noise). The sweep CSV column thinnest_feature and the sweep builder's 'by thinnest feature' already use the flawed number.

options.name: Local thickness, in Lab and the sweep
options.summary: Every solid voxel gets the diameter of the largest ball that fits in the solid and covers it (the trabecular-thickness method used by BoneJ). Report the 5th percentile by volume. Pore space the same way for the tightest gap. Replace the sweep's thinnest feature with it.
pros: The standard measure for bone and scaffolds; reads the neck on Schwarz P.
Lab and Sweep keep one definition, as decision 0010 intended.
cons: Sweep CSV thinnest-feature values change for smooth designs (they were wrong); 'by thinnest feature' sweeps step differently.
Heavier: about 1 to 3 s per design at 96³, in the background on the pool.
options.effort: About one session more: new function in 14d, a check against plates, struts and a Schwarz P neck measured analytically, sweep columns re-labelled in the notes.

options.name: Local thickness in Lab only
options.summary: Same measure as A on the Geometry tiles; the sweep keeps its current number until a separate round.
pros: No change to sweep results in this release.
cons: Two different 'thinnest' numbers in Lab until the sweep is fixed; the sweep keeps a known-wrong value.

options.name: Straight-through chord, matching the colour map
options.summary: Report the 5th percentile of the along-the-normal thickness the Wall thickness and Pore size views draw (option B of 0010).
pros: Matches the reddest spot on screen.
cons: Not a standard measure; reads thin at grazing angles; sweep still unfixed.

recommendation: It is the established thickness measure, it fixes a wrong number already in sweep results, and it keeps the one-definition promise of 0010.
